svg.title: Tools grouped by responsibility
svg.desc: Four scrolling lanes of tools. Product surfaces: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Flutter, Dart, React Native, Tailwind CSS, Motion design, Figma. Services & integrations: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Go / Gin, REST APIs, Stripe, Webhooks, Background jobs, Telegram bots. Data & real time: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Neon, Drizzle, MongoDB, Firebase, Redis, RabbitMQ. Engineering practice: System design, API design, Auth, CI/CD, Testing, Observability, Performance, Git.

g.text: The stack follows the problem — not the other way around.
